title: test(spec): re-point object-metric icon citation to index.tsx:299
body:
Fixes #21802

Clause-②: no

Before: `packages/spec/src/ui/component.test.ts:4146` cited `plugin-dashboard/src/index.tsx:204` for the `object-metric` `icon` input. At objectui `9dfaca6543` (the current `.objectui-sha`; same at the old pin `2e818d0b51ec`) that line is a lone closing brace.
After: cites `index.tsx:299`, where the `object-metric` registration (starts `:262`) declares `{ name: 'icon', type: 'string' }`.

Read evidence (read-only objectui clone at `9dfaca654311cddd81714153c4f82c241d7cdc54`): `sed -n 204p` is a closing brace; `:262` is the `'object-metric'` registration; `:299` is its icon input. (`:192` is the sibling metric registration's icon, before `:262`.)

Comment-only change in a test file; publishes nothing, no changeset.

Acceptance notes: other anchors in the same comment (`ObjectMetricWidget.tsx:142`, `:474`, `MetricWidget.tsx:312-321`, `:373-382`) do not match at this pin (e.g. `:142` is now docblock text); they read as dated, not re-pointed here per scope.
